title: Creamy Pasta Bake
description: A comforting and easy-to-make pasta dish loaded with lrich, parmesan, and cheese.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large saucepan, melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in 120g grated parmesan cheese until melted.
Combine cooked pasta, cheese sauce, and 200g shredded mozzarella cheese in a large mixing bowl.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
